items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Elmer Williams left Chick to go out there to play with him.

ctx.x: And then Chick -- Chick Webb was in there, too. Chick Webb had an eight-piece band. He had two saxophones in there. He had Johnny Hodges on alto and Elmer Williams on tenor, and he had Cootie Williams on trumpet. I don't know who the bass player was.
Was it Elmer James? Maybe Elmer James?
